sport_summary: Heavy 15-game MLB Saturday slate leads the day, with NBA and NHL playoff action rounding out the card

picks.reasoning: The Over 8.0 consensus shows an edge_bps of 291 — the highest totals edge on the entire slate — with the best price at -105 against a median of -118. Bubba Chandler takes the mound for Pittsburgh while Cristopher Sanchez starts for Philly; neither projects as a dominant strikeout arm capable of suppressing a high-powered Phillies lineup. The market is significantly split on this line, with several books pricing it down at -120, making FanDuel's -105 a genuine outlier worth attacking.

Edge_bps of 166 on the Over 9.0 is among the sharpest totals edges of the day, with the best price at -102 versus a median of -109 across 9 books. Both Kyle Leahy (Cardinals) and Noah Cameron (Royals) are fringe starters with limited track records as rotation pieces, suggesting run-scoring upside. A total of 9.0 is already elevated but the line compression from -109 to -102 at LowVig indicates sharp over money has been active.

The Brewers -1.5 run line at +146 shows a massive edge_bps of 264 — the best spread edge on the board — with the median sitting at +131 across 8 books. Logan Henderson projects as one of the stronger starters in this matchup versus Connor Prielipp, a rookie yet to establish himself at the MLB level. Getting plus-money on a team favored on the moneyline while a superior arm takes the mound is the exact spot to target the run line.

Edge_bps of 134 on Yankees -1.5 with a best price of +132 versus a median of +125 across 9 books. Carlos Rodon takes the hill for New York facing Huascar Brazoban, a relief arm making a spot start for the Mets — a significant pitching mismatch that justifies backing the Yankees to cover by multiple runs. Getting +132 on a team priced around -130 ML is excellent run-line value in a game where Rodon has the clear edge.

The Under 7.5 at +100 carries an edge_bps of 122, beating the median of -105 across 9 books — getting plus-money on an under is a clear line discrepancy worth exploiting. Sandy Alcantara starts for Miami, a proven ground-ball pitcher who limits damage, while Nick Martinez for Tampa Bay has a history of keeping games low-scoring. Two quality starters in a game with a 7.5 total suggests the books opened this conservatively and one sharp book is offering a free look at the under.

Edge_bps of 89.5 on the Cavaliers ML is below the 100 threshold but LowVig's 162 versus a median of 156 represents real value on an underdog in a playoff context. Detroit is installed as a -185 median home favorite, but Cleveland's ability to compete in playoff environments makes +162 an attractive price for a team that can absolutely win this game outright. This is a small-unit speculative play on true value rather than a heavy lean.

Edge_bps of 93 on the Over 6.5 with LowVig offering +109 against a median of +105 across 8 books — getting plus-money on an over in hockey is a legitimate edge spot. Montreal as heavy home favorites at -166 to -175 suggests they are expected to control the game and put up offense, and the Sabres offense has enough firepower to push totals over in road games. The line sitting at 6.5 on most books while BetMGM is at 6.0 indicates upward pressure on scoring expectations.
